chunks.text:
Interior Design (التصميم الداخلي) at Middle East University — about the department (department page).
The Interior Design Department has adopted a theoretical and practical program designed to prepare capable designers to actively participate in the labor market and enrich the community with skills and expertise, regionally and globally, in the field of interior design.
The program seeks to improve and develop the level of students through modern methods of teaching used globally, and to develop their personality so they can deal with modern requirements for design and implementation and meet the requirements of the field.
Looking to the future, the department strives to be at the forefront of corresponding departments by adopting the latest educational and practical means, and works to bridge the gap between the academic and practical sides of vocational training.
